iterations.notes: The CAD captures only the broadest arrangement: a mounting plate with a small hinge block and a perpendicular plate. Almost none of the distinctive hinge geometry — U-shaped link, parallel extensions, leaf flange, pintle pin with stops — is visible, so the model reads as a placeholder rather than a faithful depiction.

The CAD shows a flat plate with a small blocky fixture, which vaguely suggests a hinge mounted to a body panel, but none of the defining hinge features (U-link, pintle pin, leaf flange, parallel extensions) are identifiable. Overall fidelity to the patent figure is very low.

The CAD model shows a generic blocky assembly of plates and slabs with a small protruding pin, but it fails to reproduce the hinge's key topology: a U-shaped link with upper/lower legs, a bracket main member, and a vertical pintle. Overall silhouette and feature presence are far from the patent figure.
